title: SoftMobility: a JAX library for the mobility of soft bodies in Stokes flows
description:
SoftMobility is a Python library for modelling deformable assemblies of spheres in Stokes flows. It lets scientific users define soft bodies, compute mobility tensors, run differentiable simulations, and optimize design parameters with JAX.

This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (grant agreement No 834238).
